method.variance_ci: nested bootstrap: Sigma re-estimated in every outer draw; pivot interval for V_corr: [V_corr - q975(V_corr* - V_obs), V_corr - q025(V_corr* - V_obs)] (V_obs = bootstrap-world true finite-set variance); V_obs and V_samp reported with percentile intervals
method.null_test: common-effect null: remove the centred variant effects from every unit sum (keeps the window-level joint covariance), rerun the nested bootstrap; p = P(V_corr*_null >= V_corr)
method.sampling_fraction: V_samp / V_obs; interval = 1 - (V_corr pivot interval) / V_obs

caveat: the pivot interval treats V_corr* - V_obs as approximately pivotal; with 47 WT2 articles / 128 C4 documents and df = 4-12 it is approximate; b = 16 has 8 units and is unstable
